{{Top|leg}}
'''RW-80 welding goggles''' were eye wear used to protect someone's eyes from the bright light emanated by a welding torch. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used a pair of RW80 goggles while making repairs on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], though they were too small to fit around the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] head, forcing him to simply hold them up to his face.
